items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: The interviewer asks 'but who plays it though, Mr. Sire,' but the interviewee does not respond to this specific question about Mr. Sire, nor does he mention Mr. Sire in his subsequent narrative.

ctx.x: yes, and, nevertheless, I don't take him, I just, it takes interest into it, no more, you see, because I'm getting old, or young something, some people call them old man, some call them young man, so I don't know what I am, you know, so, I just say, well, so I made different things, I made records with this fellow, they called Joe Nicholas, and, when Joe, they called him for nickname, but I called him, Joe Nicklaus, well, they know him from Joe Nicklaus, but I called him Wooden Joe sometimes too, so we played at…
